sections.title: 2. NHS NEWS2 Physiological Escalation & UK Sepsis Six

blocks.title: UK Sepsis Six Bundle (Give 3, Take 3 Within 1 Hour)
blocks.text: When **NEWS2 >= 5** (or suspected infection + organ dysfunction): **Give** O2 to target saturation, **IV Broad-Spectrum Antibiotics**, and **IV Crystalloid Fluid Bolus**; **Take** Blood Cultures, Serum **Lactate**, and hourly **Urine Output**.

blocks.title: NEWS2 Adult Observation Scoring & Oxygen Scale Rules
rows: Assess airway, breathing effort & Sepsis Six
Titrate supplemental O2 per target prescription
Score >= 7 -> Continuous obs + Critical Care review

sections.title: 3. UK BNF Generic Naming, Controlled Drugs & Hypoglycemia

blocks.title: High-Yield UK NHS Drug Charts & SI Lab Alerts
rows: Never written as Acetaminophen/Epinephrine on NHS MAR.
Adult Paracetamol max **4 g / 24h**; Anaphylaxis IM **0.5 mg (1:1000)**.
Double-check balance & sign **CD Register** with 2 registered nurses.
Conscious & < 4.0 mmol/L: give **15–20 g oral carbohydrate**, recheck 10–15 min.

quiz.prompt: In the UK NHS/NMC OSCE, a patient's capillary blood glucose drops to 3.4 mmol/L and they are conscious and able to swallow safely. What is the immediate priority?
options: Administer 15–20 g of fast-acting oral carbohydrate and recheck in 10–15 minutes
Document and recheck during the next 4-hourly observations
Place the patient nil by mouth and wait for a doctor
quiz.rationale: In UK NICE/NHS hypoglycemia management, < 4.0 mmol/L in a conscious patient requires immediate 15–20 g fast-acting oral carbohydrate followed by a repeat glucose check at 10–15 minutes.

quiz.prompt: On an NHS NEWS2 chart, which SpO2 target range applies when caring for a COPD patient with documented hypercapnic respiratory failure (Scale 2)?
options: Oxygen targets are never prescribed on UK charts
quiz.rationale: NEWS2 Scale 2 specifies a target SpO2 of 88–92% for COPD patients with hypercapnic respiratory failure; excessive oxygen risks CO2 narcosis.

blocks.title: NCLEX Scope of Practice: Never Delegate E-A-T

items.title: Evaluation · Assessment · Teaching
items.text: Initial admissions, **blood transfusions**, IV push drugs, TPN lines, and **unstable clients** stay strictly with the RN.

items.title: Stable Treatments & Oral/IM Meds
items.text: Maintains ostomies, sterile wound dressings, Foley catheters, oral/IM meds, and collects reinforcement vitals on **stable** clients.

items.title: ADLs & Routine Measurements
items.text: Bathing, ambulation, feeding (non-dysphagia), linen changes, I&O recording, and routine vitals on **predictable** patients.

sections.title: 3. High-Yield US Conventional Labs, Antidotes & Isolation Grid

blocks.title: Must-Know US NCLEX Conventional Values & Antidotes
rows: Never IV-push KCl; check Chvostek/Trousseau in low Ca2+.
Hold **Metformin** 48h around IV contrast; watch hypoglycemia <70 mg/dL.
**Airborne (MTV):** Measles, TB, Varicella · **Droplet:** Meningitis, Pertussis · **Contact:** MRSA, C.diff
C.diff spores require **soap & water** handwashing (alcohol gel fails!).

quiz.prompt: On a US medical-surgical unit, which task can the Registered Nurse (RN) safely delegate to an Unlicensed Assistive Personnel (UAP)?
options: Administering IV push furosemide to a heart failure client
Obtaining routine morning vital signs for a stable post-op Day 2 client
Performing the initial admission assessment on a new stroke client
Teaching insulin injection technique prior to discharge
quiz.rationale: Routine vital signs on a stable client fall within UAP scope; RNs never delegate assessment, teaching, or IV push medications.

quiz.prompt: A US client receiving IV Heparin has an aPTT of 118 seconds (therapeutic 60–80 sec) and oozing from the IV site. Which reversal medication should the nurse prepare?
quiz.rationale: Protamine sulfate is the specific antidote for Heparin toxicity; Vitamin K reverses Warfarin.

canada-nnas-rexpn.eyebrow: CANADA NURSING ACADEMY · NNAS · NCLEX-RN & REx-PN
canada-nnas-rexpn.headline: Nursing in Canada (NNAS, NCLEX-RN & REx-PN Hub)

blocks.alt: Canada NNAS to provincial RN and REx-PN licensure flowchart alongside Canadian ethics competencies
blocks.caption: NNAS Advisory Sequence, NCLEX-RN vs REx-PN & Canadian Practice Competencies

blocks.title: Major Canadian Provincial Regulatory Colleges
rows: Online **CNO Jurisprudence Exam** + Supervised Practice Experience Partnership (SPEP) option
Inspire / NCAS competency assessment if bridging needed + Cultural Safety modules
Jurisprudence module + Employer currency of practice hours verification
Mandatory **OQLF French proficiency** alongside equivalence stage

blocks.title: High-Yield Canadian Exam Lens: Cultural Safety & Harm Reduction
blocks.text: Canadian boards emphasize **Indigenous Cultural Safety & Anti-Racism**, trauma-informed relational care, **Naloxone harm-reduction** without judgment, and strict respect for client autonomy including end-of-life laws (**MAiD** referral boundaries).

**SI Units Only on Exams:** Unlike US exams, Canadian NCLEX-RN and REx-PN questions present laboratory panels strictly in **SI units**: fasting glucose **3.9–5.5 mmol/L**, hemoglobin **120–160 g/L (female)**, creatinine **50–100 µmol/L**.
**Health Canada Medication Naming:** Familiarize both US and Commonwealth terms (**Acetaminophen** is standard in Canada alongside **Epinephrine**, while **Salbutamol** replaces Albuterol).

quiz.prompt: Which two Canadian provincial nursing regulators jointly administer the REx-PN exam for practical nurses?
quiz.rationale: The REx-PN was jointly developed by the College of Nurses of Ontario (CNO) and British Columbia College of Nurses and Midwives (BCCNM) with NCSBN.

blocks.title: Australian Hospital NSQHS Standards Tested on the NMBA OSCE
rows: National Hand Hygiene Initiative (**5 Moments**) & ANTT.
Verbally identify **Moment 1 (Before Patient)** & clean catheter/IV hubs
Double-check **3 Patient Identifiers** (Name, DOB, UR#) + Allergy box

blocks.title: Australian PBS Approved Generic Drug Names
blocks.text: Australian clinical charts mirror Commonwealth names (**Paracetamol**, **Adrenaline**, **Lignocaine**, **Frusemide**, **Salbutamol**) and use SI units (`mmol/L`, `g/L`).

quiz.prompt: In Australia's Ahpra/NMBA Outcomes-Based Assessment (OBA) for Registered Nurses, what are the two examination stages?
options: CBT Numeracy followed by NNAS Advisory Report
Stage 1 NCLEX-RN (cognitive) followed by Stage 2 OSCE (behavioural)
quiz.rationale: Stream B candidates complete Stage 1 (NCLEX-RN cognitive exam) and Stage 2 (Australian NMBA OSCE behavioural exam).

items.text: Tests **ABC stabilization**, DKA & renal emergencies, acute trauma, oncology, psychiatry, and NCK ethics/nursing law.

items.title: Midwifery, Reproductive Health & Community
items.text: Tests **EMOC** (Oxytocin, Pritchard **MgSO4**), Partograph interpretation, IMCI danger signs, **KEPI** vaccines (+2°C to +8°C), and SHA/community entry.

blocks.title: High-Yield Kenya Ministry of Health & NCK Priority Thresholds
rows: AMTSL with **Oxytocin 10 IU IM**; **Pritchard Regimen** (14g MgSO4 loading).
Check respirations **>=16/min**, patellar reflexes present, urine **>=30 mL/hr** before repeat MgSO4.
Monitor capillary blood glucose every 4h (watch quinine/severe malaria hypoglycemia).
Apply via **NCK Portal** with home council Good Standing + UNMC verification.
Verify practical logbook hours across Med-Surg, Midwifery & Community units.

quiz.prompt: Which regulatory body oversees KRCHN and BScN nursing registration and national licensure exams in Kenya?
quiz.rationale: The Nursing Council of Kenya (NCK) regulates nursing training, indexing, national licensing exams, and annual practice licenses in Kenya.

blocks.title: Uganda Clinical Guidelines (UCG 2023) Must-Know Regimens
rows: **IV Artesunate** (2.4 mg/kg; 3.0 mg/kg <20 kg) at 0h, 12h, 24h -> 3-day AL.
Reconstitute Artesunate in **5% Sodium Bicarbonate** + dilute with Normal Saline immediately.

Track maternal Viral Load (<1,000 copies/mL) & infant **DNA-PCR at 6 weeks**.
Maintain **Annual Practising Licence (APL)** & verified CPD logbook.
Mandatory prior to hospital placement or Good Standing verification abroad (CGFNS/NMC).

quiz.prompt: Which council issues practicing licenses and maintains the official register for nurses and midwives in Uganda?
